decisions.what: Added clearError() function called at start of appendDigit, appendDecimal, setOperator
decisions.why: Spec requires error recovery mechanism via clearError() integrated into all input handlers

decisions.what: Added equals(), clear(), backspace() named functions replacing inline handleEquals/handleClear/handleBackspace logic
decisions.why: Spec explicitly requires these function names with specific control flow

decisions.what: Changed 'Error' to 'Cannot divide by 0' in performCalculation
decisions.why: Spec requires descriptive error message for division by zero

decisions.what: backspace() returns early if isResultDisplayed (not isErrorState)
decisions.why: Spec specifies only isResultDisplayed check; error recovery is handled by clearError()

decisions.what: Updated event delegation and keyboard handlers to call equals(), clear(), backspace()
decisions.why: New named functions replace old handle* functions to match spec
